# Client

<Callout type="info">
  The client is safe to share between threads.
</Callout>

## Charge a card

<CodeTabs languages={['python', 'curl']}>

```python
client.charge(amount=1200, currency="eur")
```

```bash
curl -X POST https://api.example.invalid/v1/charges -d amount=1200
```

</CodeTabs>

Call `acme.payments.charge` for one-off payments.

## Options

| Option         | Type          | Meaning                                   |
| -------------- | ------------- | ----------------------------------------- |
| `token`        | `str`         | the bearer token                          |
| `retry_policy` | `RetryPolicy` | how failed calls are repeated, see the guide |
